name: Gecko Moria
title: Resurrect Characters from your trash with this versatile deck!
desc: This deck's greatest asset is the ability to revive Characters from your trash at a cost lower than their original cost to establish a board advantage. Combine this with black's specialty—cost-reducing effects—to keep fighting while removing cards from the field.

cards.name: Gecko Moria
cards.types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea/Thriller Bark Pirates
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] ➁ (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.) You may trash 1 card from your hand: Trash 2 cards from the top of your deck and play up to 1 {Thriller Bark Pirates} type Character card with a cost of 4 or less from your trash.

cards.name: Tsuru
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2 cost during this turn.

cards.name: Victoria Cindry
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Thriller Bark Pirates} type, trash 5 cards from the top of your deck.

cards.name: Inuppe
cards.text: [On Play]/[On K.O.] If your Leader has the {Thriller Bark Pirates} type, draw 2 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Cerberus
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Kuzan
cards.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card.
[When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −4 cost during this turn.

cards.name: Absalom
cards.text: [On Play] You may return 2 cards from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order: K.O. up to 1 Character with a cost of 2 or less.

cards.name: Dr. Hogback
cards.text: [On Play] You may return 2 cards from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order: Add up to 1 {Thriller Bark Pirates} type card other than [Dr. Hogback] from your trash to your hand.

cards.name: Perona
cards.text:
[On Play] If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, choose one:
• Your opponent trashes 1 card from their hand.
• Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3 cost during this turn.

cards.name: Sabo
cards.text:
[Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
[On Play] None of your Characters can be K.O.'d by effects until the start of your next turn. Then, draw 2 cards and trash 2 cards from your hand.

cards.name: Issho
cards.text:
[DON!! x1] [Your Turn] Give all of your opponent's Characters −3 cost.
[On Play] If your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, trash 2 cards from your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Gecko Moria
cards.types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea/Thriller Bark Pirates
cards.text: [On Play] Choose up to 1 Character card with a cost of 4 or less and up to 1 Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your trash. Play 1 card and play the other card rested.

cards.name: Ice Age
cards.text: [Main] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −5 cost during this turn.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 3 or less.

cards.name: Thriller Bark
cards.text: [Activate: Main] ➀ (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.) You may rest this Stage: If your Leader has the {Thriller Bark Pirates} type, play up to 1 {Thriller Bark Pirates} type Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your trash rested.
